label.en: Landing page for one product or offer

expects.rule: The page has one goal and one primary action, repeated at the top, in the middle and at the end with the same wording.
The first screen says what is offered, for whom and at what cost or condition (price, free trial, quote) without scrolling.
Proof sits next to the action: a number, a named customer, a quote, or a demo the visitor can try.
The navigation is reduced to a few links or none, so the visitor is not led away from the action.
The form or purchase step asks for the minimum: an email, or a single button to a checkout.
The page works on a phone: the action button is reachable without hunting, text is at least 16px, and nothing depends on hover.
The page answers the main objections (price, setup time, platform support) in a short block before the final action.

traits: Header holds 6 links or fewer on 7 of 7 sites (Clips 3, AccessGrid 4, Tegra 4, ZIRKA 4, Nucleo 5, Buzzabout 6) plus one coloured action button on 5 of 7.
Headline is 2 to 3 lines at 46 to 88px on 6 of 7 sites; Nucleo runs one line of capitals across the width.
The first screen holds fewer than 50 words on 5 of 7 sites; Tegra and Clips carry a paragraph of 30 to 45 words.
One filled button plus a quieter secondary action on 3 of 7 (Clips, Buzzabout, AccessGrid); Tegra, Raycast and ZIRKA show a single action.
A large visual takes about half or more of the first screen on 6 of 7: product photograph, mock-up, sphere or artwork; Clips is type only.
Typefaces: 2 or 3 named families per site on 7 of 7; a mono face on ZIRKA and Raycast.
Backgrounds are near-black on 3 of 7 (Clips, ZIRKA, Raycast) and white or light grey on 4 of 7; one saturated accent (lime, red, blue, orange).

sites.name: Clips
sites.why: Near-black page (#0a0a0a), a floating pill nav with How it works, Pricing and a lime (#b4f213) Buy $59 button, a centred three-line headline in Uncut Sans, a four-line paragraph, then a lime Buy Clips $59 button above a grey Try it free. No image on the first screen.

sites.name: Tegra
sites.why: White page, a very large red (#e43e1e) wordmark, a four-link nav stacked at the right, a three-line headline in a grotesque at left, a short paragraph and a red Request a quote button, beside a black-and-white photograph of two workers laying steel studs.

sites.name: ZIRKA Interceptor
sites.why: Full-screen dark photograph of the product's fins and nozzle, a thin HUD bar with a live clock, four anchor links and an orange Contact us button, grey mono readouts at the top left, and a three-line headline at bottom left set in Inter Display. Mono text in Geist Mono.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day, 2026-11-09 (also Developer Award, per the earlier pass)

sites.name: Buzzabout
sites.why: White page, left-aligned two-line headline in Geist at 59px, a two-line grey subline, a black Try for free button and an outlined Book a demo, a row of six grey social icons, and a rotating sphere of social-post thumbnails at right. Nav: Home, Features, Pricing, API, Compare, Partnerships; Log in.
sites.recognition: Listed on SaaS Landing Page gallery, opened 2026-11-12 (listing date not shown)

sites.name: AccessGrid
sites.why: Light grey page (light grey) with a floating nav (Developers, Pricing, About, Sign in, blue Get started), a three-line 64px headline in a grotesque at left, a paragraph with the time promise in bold, a blue and a grey button, and a phone showing a wallet card at right.
sites.recognition: Listed on SaaS Landing Page gallery, opened 2026-11-12 (listing date not shown)

sites.name: Raycast
sites.why: Near-black page (#07080a), a floating nav with a Download button, a centred two-line headline in Inter at 64px over a full-bleed artwork of diagonal red, white and blue streaks; no product screen on the first view. Claims below are one word plus a sentence.
sites.recognition: Listed on SaaS Landing Page gallery, opened 2026-11-12 (listing date not shown)

sites.name: Nucleo
sites.why: Off-white page (#fafafa), a five-item header ending in a purple Buy Icons button, a single-line heavy-capitals headline in Geist across the full width, then large tiles of live icon grids from three families. A web app teaser and designer testimonials follow.
sites.recognition: Listed on SaaS Landing Page gallery, opened 2026-11-12 (listing date not shown)

avoid: A full website menu (ten links, a footer sitemap) on a page meant to get one action.
Several competing buttons of equal weight in the first screen.
A hero with a stock photo of people at laptops, or an abstract gradient, and no view of the offer.
Fake urgency (countdown that resets, "only 3 left") and invented testimonials.
A long form on the first screen when an email address would do.
Text over a moving background without enough contrast, or content that only appears after scroll animations.
